🎥🎬: Roman J. Israel, Esq. (2017)

Roman J. Israel is a brilliant but socially awkward defense attorney who has spent decades fighting for justice behind the scenes. When his longtime law partner dies unexpectedly, Roman is thrust into a modern legal world that challenges his idealistic beliefs and forces him to confront difficult choices about morality, ambition, and survival.

As he becomes involved with a high-profile law firm and faces the consequences of one life-altering decision, Roman struggles to reconcile his unwavering principles with the harsh realities of the justice system. His journey becomes a powerful exploration of integrity, redemption, and the cost of doing what is right.

Starring Denzel Washington, Roman J. Israel, Esq. is a thought-provoking legal drama that showcases one of Washington’s most acclaimed performances.

source_details.synopsis: Roman J. Israel, Esq. is a 2017 American legal drama film written and directed by Dan Gilroy. The film stars Denzel Washington and Colin Farrell, and follows the life of a civil-rights advocate and defense lawyer (Washington), who finds himself in a tumultuous series of events that lead to a personal crisis and the necessity for extreme action. The project was announced on August 25, 2016, as Gilroy's next directorial effort titled Inner City, but was renamed on June 22, 2017. Principal photography began in March 2017, and took place in Los Angeles and Santa Clarita, California. Roman J.
